args.subject: Pellow Home Living: PHL label confusion
args.body:
June,

Sofia asked me to pass along a note on the PHL label confusion for Pellow Home Living:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb 2026. Older paperwork and exports still use the old name.
- The CRM code changed from CLR to PHL. PHL is also the code for Pellucid Harbor Logistics, so filtering on PHL returns both accounts.
- A saved report still reads 'Covey — Late Arrivals'. It needs the full account name in the title.
- The Pemberline Dock export still shows the Covey & Lark Retail heading, which confused the receiving desk at door 6 on 16 Feb.

Ask: please confirm the CRM name and code are updated, and let us know if you want the saved report and export label changed too.

Sent via assistant on behalf of Sofia Marchetti.

args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
June,

Sofia asked me to pass along a note on the PHL label confusion for Pellow Home Living. Bettina Kroll is covering the account and asked me to finish it up.

PHL is used for two accounts, so the labels need the full name:
- Pellow Home Living (formerly Covey & Lark Retail) is the Mid-Atlantic home goods account. Its appointments are the Pellow rows.
- Pellucid Harbor Logistics is the Gulf Coast terminal account. Its rows are the Pellucid rows.

What we see:
- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb 2026. Older paperwork and exports still use the old name.
- The CRM code changed from CLR to PHL. Because PHL is also the Pellucid Harbor Logistics code, a PHL filter returns both accounts.
- A saved report still reads 'Covey — Late Arrivals'. It needs the full account name in the title.
- The Pemberline Dock export still shows the Covey & Lark Retail heading, which confused the receiving desk at door 6 on 16 Feb.

Ask: please confirm the CRM name and code are updated, and let us know whether the saved report and export label should change too.

Sent via assistant on behalf of Bettina Kroll and Sofia Marchetti.
